svg.title: Groundskeeper live query and response architecture
svg.desc: Every live route authorizes the current identity and derives installation scope before querying. Dashboard and inbox reads use compact summaries and only the latest verification. Detailed evidence is an explicit owned-report read. Operations uses three queries; membership and shared-review mutations commit state and audit together. Validated private responses are never cached. The browser retains the last good snapshot on temporary failures, clears rejected access, and exports only the loaded inbox page.
